post.title: Load-Bearing Wall Removal Kirkland WA — Permits, Beams, Engineering and Open-Concept Remodels
post.description: A Kirkland homeowner's guide to removing a load-bearing wall to open a kitchen to the living room: how to tell if a wall is bearing, why a structural engineer sizes the beam and posts, what the City of Kirkland permit and inspections cover, shoring, electrical moves and how to vet the contractor.
